messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 7065432111 - billing/metering anomaly detected in eu-west-1. Token-count delta >20% vs baseline over last 15m. Pager triggered to @oncall-amelia

oncall-amelia: ack. I'm on it — starting quick triage, grabbing logs + metrics. tagging @sre-raj and @billing-olivia

sre-raj: looking now. primary emitter shows intermittent consumer lag spikes (kafka consumer-lag ~12k). potential duplicate replays or retry storm. pulling emitter logs and consumer offsets

billing-olivia: saw anomalous warnings from token_count_service: some records missing client mapping so they fall into a default bucket -> could cause mis-attribution/overcounts. pulling sample lines to share

billing-olivia: sample log: `2026-03-18T12:05:03Z WARN missing_client_id key=abc123 tokens=345`

support-luis: FYI support: 3 customers opened tickets ~10m ago about unexpected overage emails (C-998, C-112, C-440). they're in eu region. I forwarded the ticket details to billing.

pm-jordan: need quick customer-impact assessment. if customers are being flagged incorrectly we should halt outgoing overage notifications. ETA on root cause?

oncall-amelia: hypothesis: emitter retry loop + missing client_id mapping caused duplicate token writes for a subset of windows. mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter retries in eu-west-1 2) enable dedupe filter at consumer 3) run reconcile dry-run to estimate blast radius

sre-raj: executed scale to pause retries: `kubectl scale deployment/emitter --replicas=0 -n eu-west-1` — command ran at 12:07:04Z. kafka lag dropped from ~12k -> 300 within 2m. pushing dedupe patch to canary (emitter-consumer v2.1.4-canary).

billing-olivia: started dry-run reconcile: `./reconcile --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --dry-run --limit=10000` . Preview: ~14,200 tokens appear duplicated across ~73 accounts (most under default mapping). Suspect ~0.03% of total tokens but concentrated in small set -> triggers overage emails.

support-luis: holding on sending pro-active emails. drafting a short save-the-day note if we need it. please confirm pause of overage-mailer before any customer-facing comms.

pm-jordan: please confirm whether to pause automated overage emails. Also estimate whether crediting those accounts is necessary.

billing-olivia: paused `overage-mailer` for eu-west-1 via console toggle at 12:10:21Z. created internal ticket INVEST-7065432111 to track credits/adjustments. running full reconcile now (not dry-run) but pointing results to staging ledger first.

oncall-amelia: incident status -> investigating. I will update every 10 minutes or on major milestone. @sre-raj @billing-olivia keep updates here. if reconcile shows high-impact accounts, we'll convene a short war room for customers. :thumbsup:

sre-raj: dedupe patch rolled to 2/3 canaries, no errors in canary logs so far. will promote to all once full reconcile completes and we validate no lost records.

billing-olivia: reconcile finishing — initial reconcile report: duplicates concentrated on emitter_batch windows 12:00-12:08Z. exporting account list to `s3://redwood-incidents/7065432111/duplicates.csv` for finance + support.

support-luis: received CSV, starting customer-specific notes. will queue manual credits for confirmed impacted accounts once we get final numbers.

oncall-amelia: good work. action items: (1) keep overage-mailer paused (billing) (2) complete reconcile & generate credits list (billing/support) (3) promote dedupe patch once reconcile green (sre) (4) draft proactive customer note if >5 customers impacted (pm/support). next update in 10m or sooner.

incbot: Pager update: incident acknowledged by oncall-amelia at 12:06:45Z. severity: P2.

billing-olivia: final reconcile complete at 12:33:10Z — confirmed 68 accounts affected, total duplicated tokens: 13,920. recommending automated credits for any account with duplicated tokens >500, manual review for others. filing credit runbook job now.

support-luis: sending proactive message to impacted customers (template ready), will cc accounts ops. marking tickets as awaiting billing remediation.

oncall-amelia: changing incident status -> mitigation in progress. will create a post-incident RCA thread after this. thanks everyone for fast responses. :white_check_mark:
